facebook.caption:
Five November 2026 Web3 gatherings still ahead on Nov 2: Mumbai, Toronto, Cape Town, London and Sydney. Dates, program and entry terms below were checked against organizer pages on Oct 20.

1. Devcon 8 | Nov 3-6, 2026 | Mumbai, India. Ethereum talks and workshops cover core protocol, privacy and security. Paid general admission has no eligibility test; discounted tickets have separate conditions.

2. Toronto VibeStation | Nov 6, 2026 | Toronto, Canada. Superteam Canada's Solana coworking day includes project work, lunch and snacks. Free; public applications require approval. Exact address is shared with guests.

3. W3Node | Nov 12-14, 2026 | Cape Town, South Africa. Keynotes, technical workshops and a 3-day hackathon at Parkview Event Space. Paid conference passes; free hacker participation by application.

4. Solana Breakpoint | Nov 15-17, 2026 | London, UK. Olympia Convention Centre; stablecoins, tokenized assets and payments. Paid general, developer and student ticket categories.

5. CryptoCon Sydney | Nov 28-29, 2026 | Sydney, Australia. ICC Sydney: regulation, startups and blockchain infrastructure. General admission covers expo and speakers for free; premium events require a paid pass.
